{{Quote|According to Imperial records, Master Rahm Kota was a respected general in the Clone Wars.|PROXY|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
'''Rahm Kota''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Born on a [[Rahm Kota's homeworld|war-torn world]], Kota [[Ground warfare/Legends|fought in the trenches]] during the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] internal conflicts from the age of ten. At the age of eighteen, Kota met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who had been dispatched to the planet to end the conflict peacefully. Discovering Kota's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Windu took Kota back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a Jedi. Despite being well over the traditional age of acceptance, Kota was schooled in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. As a Jedi Master, Kota took [[Falon Grey]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] sometime before the Clone Wars, training him to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]]. During the Clone Wars, Kota was made a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Unlike the other Jedi Generals, Kota did not believe that [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were fit for battle and refused to lead them. Instead, he commanded [[Kota's Militia|his own militia]], comprised of volunteers. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued&mdash;an [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|emergency contingency]] that ordered the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces to [[Death/Legends|terminate]] their Jedi commanders, who had been deemed a threat to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]&mdash;Kota survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|slaughter]] of his fellow Jedi since there were no clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] serving with him.

Going into hiding with his militia, Kota allied himself with [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. Kota began striking at [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets, taking interest in the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and hoping to draw him into a confrontation. This culminated in a [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|mission]] to seize a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Kota believed that he could draw Vader out with the strike but was instead confronted by the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]]. The two [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] in the facility's command center; Kota was beaten and blinded but managed to escape the confrontation. With his confidence shaken&mdash;and his connection to the Force seemingly gone&mdash;Kota turned to [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] and went into hiding in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. He was [[Skirmish on Cloud City|discovered by the apprentice]] he had dueled on Nar Shaddaa, who wanted his help in fighting the Empire. The apprentice&mdash;who had been tasked by Vader to create a rebellion with which to oppose [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;wanted Kota to instruct him in the Force. Kota suspected that the young man before him was the same man who had blinded him, but&mdash;through the Force&mdash;Kota sensed a bright spot within him that gave him hope that the apprentice could be [[Light side of the Force/Legends|turned away]] from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Kota agreed to help the apprentice and assisted him in making contact with Senator Organa, Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|through]] a [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|series]] [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|of]] [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|missions]]. Together, they pledged to form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to fight against the Empire. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Kota recovered much of his former self and restored his connection to the Force.

During the subsequent meeting of the [[Corellian Treaty]] to formally create the Rebellion against the Empire, Vader attacked the assemblage with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial forces]]. The apprentice&mdash;who had come to renounce his ties to Vader and the Empire&mdash;had attempted to keep the meeting secret but had been discovered. Kota was captured, along with the gathered senators, and taken to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star battlestation]] under construction in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]]. Kota was to be interrogated and executed by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself. The apprentice&mdash;who had been left for dead on Corellia&mdash;infiltrated the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and [[Battle on Death Star I|fought]] his way to the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. After engaging and beating Vader in a duel, the apprentice rescued Kota from a [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] attack by the Emperor. While the apprentice held off the Emperor, Kota and the senators escaped the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] aboard the apprentice's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]''. Regrouping on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Kota joined in the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]], an official proclamation of the group's intent to oppose the Empire's rule.

Over the next [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Kota served as a general in the new Alliance, using his own [[Kota's squad|squad]] of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to assault Imperial targets. Captured during a [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|mission]] to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], he was forced to fight in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat for the amusement of the world's ruler, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. Kota was eventually rescued by [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a clone of the apprentice. Although Starkiller was more interested in finding [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]&mdash;who had been captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and taken to Vader&mdash;than in fighting the Empire, he provided Kota with coordinates and schematics for the cloning facilities located at [[Timira City]] on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Kota led the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to the [[Water/Legends|water]] world, [[Assault on Kamino|engaging]] an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in battle. With Starkiller's aid, the Alliance claimed victory at Kamino, rescuing Eclipse and capturing Vader. Kota was later responsible for the recruitment of [[X2]], a Force-sensitive clone of his former Padawan, Falon Grey, into the Rebel Alliance.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born and raised on a [[Rahm Kota's homeworld|war-ravaged planet]], Rahm Kota fought in the brutal [[Ground warfare/Legends|trench warfare]] that devastated his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from before the age of ten. Eventually, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to [[Diplomat/Legends|negotiate]] a peaceful resolution to the conflict. Windu met and befriended Kota, now aged eighteen, and found that he was strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After completing his mission, Windu sought to have Kota return with him to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] in the Jedi arts. Despite the fact that he was well past the traditional age of acceptance for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|new apprentices]], Kota was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and trained under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] himself. During his training, his gruff and forthright personality earned him few friends. After attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Kota often questioned the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] decisions and voiced his opinion that the Order should adopt a more forceful approach when dealing with criminals or negotiating treaties. Yet, no one doubted Kota's commitment and loyalty to both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the Jedi, or his courage, as he always chose the most dangerous and hazardous assignments.<ref name="TFUdb" />

At some point, Kota took [[Falon Grey]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and trained him as a Jedi. Grey was badly injured sometime prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and Kota landed on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for medical assistance. The native [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] healed Grey but took a genetic sample from him<ref name="ES-DS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''&mdash;[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version</ref> without his knowledge or consent.<ref name="ES-PSP">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''&mdash;[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] version</ref> Unbeknownst to Kota and Grey, the Kaminoans&mdash;who were renowned [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]]&mdash;used the sample to create two clones, designated [[X1]] and [[X2]].<ref name="ES" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Master Kota was a military genius, but felt the clone soldiers were unfit for battle. Instead, he relied on his own militia.|PROXY|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kota.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Rahm Kota]]
By the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in 22 BBY, Kota was a Jedi Master and was appointed as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] alongside his contemporaries. However, Kota believed that the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] produced by the Kaminoans were not fit to be [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and refused to lead them into combat.<ref name="TFUcg">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> He did not believe that clones could be as creative or as intelligent in the field as non-clones.<ref name="TFUdb" /> Instead, he organized and trained [[Kota's Militia|his own militia]], comprising dedicated beings from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="TFUcg" /> which included members of local planetary militias, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups, and even [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]-of-war.<ref name="TFUdb" /> Kota and his militia served with distinction, fighting as both a regular unit and a [[Special forces/Legends|special operations]] force<ref name="TFUcg" /> on several fronts, including several successful offensives in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TFUdb" /> Kota began to grow weary of watching his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and friends [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the war and firmly believed that the conflict would eventually see the destruction of both the Jedi and the Republic and the rise of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TFUcg" />

[[19 BBY/Legends|Three years after]] the start of the war, Palpatine issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to all clone units, which stated that the Jedi had become a threat to the Republic and thus had to be eliminated. Palpatine was actually a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] operating under the name [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, and the entire war was part of an elaborate plan to destroy the Jedi Order and have the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rule the galaxy. Palpatine named himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and reorganized the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> Kota's decision to lead his own [[Troop/Legends|troops]] spared him the fate that befell most of the Jedi commanders in the Grand Army by the simple fact that he had no clones under his command. A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] serving with Kota learned of the order and immediately took him and his troops into hiding.<ref name="TFUcg" /> Stealing a Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], Kota and his forces disappeared into the Outer Rim,<ref name="TFUdb" /> his fears having become reality.<ref name="TFUcg" /> Following his disappearance, Kota was officially listed as dead in Imperial records, although [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Palpatine's new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], was aware that he had survived.<ref name="TFUn" />

===The Dark Times===
====Striking back at the Empire====
[[File:Kota_and_militia.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kota, with members of his militia]]
Kota fled to the Outer Rim Territories, where he decided to dedicate his life to opposing the new Galactic Empire. After he established a number of small bases, new recruits flocked to his banner as the Empire tightened its grip on the galaxy. He and his militia remained hidden, emerging only to strike at Imperial targets in well-executed and carefully planned raids.<ref name="TFUcg" /> Kota allied himself with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], who was fomenting rebellion within the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|halls]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and secretly assisting fugitive Jedi who had escaped Order 66. Organa began feeding Kota data on Imperial targets, allowing the [[General/Legends|General]] to strike deep at the Empire's [[Imperial Military/Legends|war machine]]. Through Organa, Kota was able to maintain communications with other Jedi, including [[Ylenic It'kla]], who was serving as the Senator's [[Aide/Legends|aide]]; [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], who was in hiding on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]; and [[Kazdan Paratus]], who had taken refuge on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TFUn" />

While conducting his rebellion, Kota took an intense interest in Darth Vader himself, attacking targets that appeared to have some level of importance to the Dark Lord, such as assaulting a factory that he had recently visited and stealing a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that Vader had used as a personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="TFUcg" /> His main aim was to finally draw Vader into a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|confrontation]] with himself so that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] could be eliminated once and for all.<ref name="TFUn" />

====Drawing out the Dark Lord====
{{Quote|A ''boy?'' Months of attacking Imperial targets, and Vader sends a ''boy'' to fight me?|Rahm Kota, to Darth Vader's secret apprentice|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], using information gained from Organa, Kota [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|struck at]] a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], hoping that the bold action would finally force Vader to face him. Kota and his militia boarded the [[Space station/Legends|station]], engaging its [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] complement and placing explosive charges throughout the facility at strategic points. As Kota's Militia secured the command center, a [[Rogue Shadow|vessel]] was detected on approach to the facility. Kota believed that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was bringing Darth Vader to face him and ordered the [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]] on [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] twelve to be lowered so that the Dark Lord could board the facility.<ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:Kota_vs_Starkiller2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kota dueling with the secret apprentice.]]
Kota waited in the facility's command center for Vader but was surprised to find that the intruder was not the Dark Lord of the Sith, but rather a [[Galen Marek|young man]] who was Vader's own secret apprentice. Despite his shock, Kota engaged the apprentice in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel and found the boy stronger in the Force than he had thought.<ref name="TFUn" /> Unwilling to let the apprentice live, Kota used the Force to detach the command center from the construction facility, continuing to battle the [[darksider]] as it plummeted toward the surface of Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TFUvg" /> The two continued to duel, but the apprentice was stronger, and Kota began to tire, taking several hits that reduced his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robe]] to a smoking ruin and caused one of his shoulder pads to glow [[red]] hot. Kota was caught in a [[Telekinesis/Legends|chokehold]] by the apprentice and battered with flying debris until he was knocked to the ground. Vader's apprentice brought his lightsaber blade down, engaging the General in a saber lock. Kota received a [[Farsight/Legends|glimpse]] of the apprentice's future as the combatant's blades were forced closer to his face, sensing that Vader would not always be his opponent's master and that he had not been turned fully to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. He was also astonished to see that the apprentice's future included himself. In that moment, the apprentice pushed the locked blades toward Kota's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], blinding the General.<ref name="TFUn" />

In agony, Kota sent out a wave of [[Force energy]] that shattered the [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] of the command center, dropping [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] in the process. Wind howled through the command center as debris was sucked out due to the drastic change of pressure, and Kota followed, dropping spread-eagle into the Vertical City below. Vader's apprentice retrieved Kota's lightsaber, taking it as a trophy of his victory.<ref name="TFUn" />

====Fall from grace====
Although blinded, Kota survived the fall from the command center, landing on a transport,<ref name="TFUc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref> and went into hiding on Nar Shaddaa. Falling into despair, the General found his connection to the Force severely diminished and believed that he had lost the connection completely. In response, he turned to [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] to ease the loss. He also used a bandage to cover his blinded eyes. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the incident, he was found by Bail Organa, who wanted to recruit Kota in a mission to rescue his adopted daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. The Princess had been sent to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], ostensibly as a [[Senatorial Observer]] and the guest of Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]], who was supervising the construction of a [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|skyhook]] above the planet. In reality, Leia Organa was being held as a hostage to stop her [[Parent/Legends|father]] from speaking out against the Empire in the Senate. Kota refused to help Organa, feeling that his condition made him useless for such a task. The Senator arranged transportation for Kota to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] via [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], informing him that he intended to seek help from Master Shaak Ti on Felucia instead. Although Kota warned him against that course of action, Organa went anyway.<ref name="TFUn" />

===Birth of the Rebellion===
====An unlikely apprentice====
{{Quote|We need to rally the Emperor's enemies. And I need to find someone who can teach me the things that Vader couldn't&hellip;''"<br />"''Sounds like we're still hunting Jedi.''"<br />"''And I know one that might still be alive.''"<br />"''General Kota?''"<br />"''Yes. When I fought him, he said he'd be part of my future. Well, let's hope he was right. Head to Nar Shaddaa.|Galen Marek and Juno Eclipse|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kotadrunk2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kota, drunk in the Vapor Room]]
On Cloud City, Kota took refuge in the [[Vapor Room]], a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that catered to [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]], paying for exclusive use of a table. Ignoring the galaxy at large, Kota let his appearance degrade; his hair became greasy and ill-kept, and his robes were loose-fitting and stained. Despite Kota's attempts to keep a low profile, word of the presence of a blind man who could nevertheless pour a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] of [[Corellian brandy/Legends|Corellian brandy]] without spilling a drop reached the [[Ear/Legends|ears]] of the Empire.<ref name="TFUn" />

[[Standard month/Legends|Months]] after his encounter with Vader's apprentice over Nar Shaddaa, Kota was woken from a drunken stupor by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual requesting his help. Kota pointed out that he was of no use due to his injuries, although the young man countered by informing him that he needed his mind and experience in fighting the Empire, not his eyes. Through his weak connection with the Force, Kota suspected that the individual in front of him was the same man who had dueled and blinded him over Nar Shaddaa. Feeling that Vader had not turned the man completely to the dark side, Kota found something within the apprentice&mdash;a single bright spot that burned within him, that gave him hope and to which he clung. The apprentice, however, was still in league with Vader, who had mandated him to create a rebellion through which the two of them could depose the Emperor.<ref name="TFUn" />

At that moment, Imperial [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|forces]], tipped off to Kota's presence by a local [[Spy/Legends|informant]], raided the Vapor Room. The apprentice fought his way out of the bar, covering Kota while the blind and drunk Jedi Master attempted to navigate his way out of the [[Water/Legends|watering]] hole. During the [[Skirmish on Cloud City|ensuing battle]], Kota became separated from the apprentice, making his own way to the balloon dock, where the young man had arranged a rendezvous with his ship. Despite having come to believe that the Empire was unbeatable and nothing that they could do would ever defeat it, Kota agreed to help the apprentice, noting that he had a friend in the Senate who could use his lightsaber. When he asked the young man if he had a name, the apprentice told him that he had none.<ref name="TFUn" />

====Gathering allies====
{{Quote|It's a fool's errand, boy. The Empire's army is infinite. You'll eventually be killed&hellip;or worse. And nothing will have changed.''"<br />"''Wouldn't you rather die on your feet than drown in some cantina?''"<br />"''I don't know. But I do have a contact in the Senate who could use your lightsaber.|Rahm Kota, to Galen Marek on Cloud City|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Blind_Kota.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kota, with bandages covering his ruined eyes]]
Once aboard the ''Rogue Shadow'', the apprentice's vessel, Kota met with the other members of the crew&mdash;the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Captain [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PROXY]]. Given access to a [[Comm unit/Legends|communications console]], Kota attempted to contact Bail Organa but failed to do so. Remembering that Organa had attempted to recruit him to rescue his daughter, Leia, he reasoned that extracting her from Kashyyyk might make the Senator more liable to listen to the mysterious young man. Kota directed the ship to Kashyyyk, telling his new companions that there was something of value to the Senator on the surface and that retrieving it would be in their best interests, although he neglected to mention that it was Organa's daughter. On approach to the Wookiee homeworld, Kota questioned Eclipse over the vessel they were in; the former [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] told them it was stolen and tried to forestall any further conversation in case she gave away that the ship was the same one that had ferried the apprentice&mdash;whom she knew by the codename "Starkiller"&mdash;and herself to Nar Shaddaa. Kota told her not to worry, as they were all fugitives. Kota stated that he was not about to turn Eclipse in to the Empire.<ref name="TFUn" />

While the apprentice [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|fought]] his way through Imperial forces on Kashyyyk, Kota continued to refuse to tell him exactly what he was looking for, telling him that he would know it when he found it. When the apprentice did eventually find the Princess, she refused to go with him, telling him that she could not leave until the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] that was being constructed in orbit was destroyed. The apprentice agreed to attempt to destroy it so that the Princess would take her shuttle and leave planet. En route to the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] mooring that kept the skyhook in orbit, the apprentice stumbled across a [[Kento Marek's hut|hut]] that he was drawn to and asked Kota for advice. Kota warned him off from entering it, telling him that there were some things that he was not ready to learn, and that if he entered, he had to face whatever was inside alone. The apprentice ignored Kota and entered. Through his weak connection to the Force, Kota felt something of the apprentice's experience, causing him to sag against the control panels. The hut had been the apprentice's former home, where he had lived with [[Kento Marek|his father]] when he was a child, and the young man received a vision of his father's death at the hands of Darth Vader.<ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:Kota_Marek_1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The secret apprentice confers with Kota.]]
Eventually, the apprentice destroyed the skyhook and returned to the ''Rogue Shadow'', where he demanded to know the identity of the woman he had just rescued. Kota filled him in on her identity and that of her father, and the apprentice demanded to speak with Organa. Kota admitted that he had been unable to reach Organa since they left Bespin and that Organa had gone to find Shaak Ti. Before Kota could reveal that Felucia was their destination, the apprentice revealed it himself. Kota commented that he must have been strong in the Force in order to read his thoughts, although the truth was that the apprentice had been to the planet previously and [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|killed]] Shaak Ti.<ref name="TFUn" /> Before heading to Felucia, however, Kota accompanied the apprentice to Coruscant, the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]], so that the young man could infiltrate the ruins of the Jedi Temple and find information on his father and the vision he had on Kashyyyk. Kota guided the apprentice through the ruins by [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The apprentice found what he was looking for and returned to the ship.<ref name="TFU-USE">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition]]'' {{C|Jedi Temple downloadable content level}}</ref>

On Felucia, Kota refused the apprentice's offer to join him in retrieving Organa, stating that he was basically useless in his current condition. The young man succeeded in [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|his mission]], defeating Shaak Ti's corrupted apprentice, [[Maris Brood]], in the process, which led to a reunion between Kota and Organa. Organa revealed that Shaak Ti was dead, and Kota commented that her killer was probably the same individual who had blinded him. In return, he revealed to Organa that he could not contact Kazdan Paratus on Raxus Prime and feared the worst. In a conversation between them and the apprentice, the young man brought up the concept of open rebellion against the Empire. Kota commented that they would need a victory&mdash;a big target&mdash;to convince potential allies that they were not just talking but were prepared to take action. The apprentice told them that he would meditate on the matter and eventually returned to Kota with a target in mind&mdash;a new Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that was producing [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that had been established in orbit over Raxus Prime. In truth, however, the target had been suggested to the apprentice by Vader himself.<ref name="TFUn" />

On the way to Raxus Prime, Kota sensed that Eclipse&mdash;who had discovered that the apprentice was still in contact with Vader and the two were conspiring to bring down the Emperor&mdash;was troubled about something. In addition, he almost discovered that she and the apprentice had been to Raxus Prime before when she slipped up, sarcastically mentioning that it was good to see the planet again. She covered it by claiming to have made dumping runs to the planet in the past. In reality, she had ferried the apprentice to the planet to kill Paratus, a [[First mission to Raxus Prime|task]] at which he had succeeded. As Eclipse laid out a plan to destroy the shipyard&mdash;by commandeering the [[ore cannon]] on the surface of the planet and using it to destabilize the facility's orbit&mdash;Kota inquired if there had been any word from Paratus since they arrived, only to be told that there was no sign of him.<ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:The_Force_Unleashed_092.jpg|thumb|left|A crippled Star Destroyer plunges toward Raxus Prime.]]
As the apprentice [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|made his way]] across the surface of the planet toward the [[Ore/Legends|ore]] cannon, Kota retired to the cargo bay of the ''Rogue Shadow''. While he was sequestered away, PROXY, who was attempting to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the planet's [[Core (Raxus Prime)|Core computer]] so that he could assist the apprentice in adjusting the aim of the ore cannon, was infected by the [[Computer/Legends|supercomputer's]] intelligence. The Core convinced the droid to carry out his primary programming&mdash;attempting to kill his master&mdash;while the apprentice was engaged with the mission. To this end, PROXY temporarily incapacitated Eclipse, overrode the ''Rogue Shadow''{{'s}} launch codes, and left the ship.<ref name="TFUn" />

Shortly after reprogramming the ore cannon and firing three shots at the orbiting shipyard, the apprentice became aware that one of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that was under construction was falling out of orbit toward the planet. Contacting the ''Rogue Shadow'', the apprentice frantically ordered Eclipse to take off immediately. Instead, he got Kota, who had discovered PROXY's actions. With no option to fly the ship out of danger, Kota told the apprentice that he would have to use the Force to pull the Star Destroyer into the cannon itself. When the apprentice expressed disbelief, Kota told him that size did not matter to a Jedi. As he told the apprentice what he had to do to save them all, the drunken slur in his voice disappeared, and he recovered some of the confidence and bearing of the seasoned general that he had once been.<ref name="TFUn" />

As the apprentice used the Force to grip the Star Destroyer and bring it down into the cannon itself, the resulting impact sent shockwaves through the planet's massed trash heaps. The waves rocked the ''Rogue Shadow'', forcing Kota to hang onto the co-pilot's seat as the ship bucked underneath him. As the waves stopped, the General called for the apprentice over comlink, desperate to make sure he was still alive. Finally assured that he was, Kota told the young man that PROXY had incapacitated them and left the ship to go after him. While Eclipse and the apprentice were worried about PROXY's state of mind, Kota reminded them that the droid had been infected by an Imperial computer and that the droid had been carrying all the plans for the forthcoming rebellion. PROXY was a security risk that had to be taken care of, one way or the other. The apprentice dealt with the droid, defeating him in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and returned him to the ship.<ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:Garmgarmgarm.jpg|thumb|right|Senator Garm Bel Iblis]]
As the apprentice recovered from pulling the Star Destroyer down, Kota informed him that he had set up a meeting with [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] on Cloud City. Traveling there in the ''Rogue Shadow'', Kota told the young man to find [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], who was able to give him Bel Iblis' current location. The apprentice learned that Bel Iblis had been captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kleef]], who was working for [[Chop'aa Notimo]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] in turn working for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate who was attempting a takeover of Cloud City. The apprentice managed to [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|rescue]] Bel Iblis, who agreed to join the rebellion and suggested that they meet further with Bail Organa.<ref name="TFU-alternate">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''&mdash;[[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], PSP, and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] versions only</ref>

Following the apprentice's rescue of Bel Iblis, the Senator joined with Organa and Mothma in a [[Cantham House Meetings|series of meetings]] in Organa's [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]] residence. While the three dissident Senators hashed out the basic plans for an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Kota, Eclipse, and the apprentice went to ground on the planet [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]]. Located in the Outer Rim, Rhommamool's location close to the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] meant that [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions were readily available, but its remoteness ensured a low level of Imperial activity.<ref name="TFUn" />

During their enforced wait, Kota attempted to learn more about the apprentice; specifically, who had taught him in the ways of the Force and of the lightsaber. Kota was unable to recognize the style and told the apprentice that if he knew who his original teacher was, it would help him to understand him better. The apprentice asked who needed to understand him; Kota replied that Bel Iblis definitely would need to. To Bel Iblis, the apprentice was an unknown quantity, and that made him a possible military threat. The apprentice was evasive in his answers but related his experience with Maris Brood on Felucia. When Kota inquired if his original master had suffered the same fate as Brood, the apprentice refused to answer. Frustrated, Kota returned to his private musings. After eight days at Rhommamool, Kota received word from Organa that the meeting to formalize the creation of a rebellion against the Empire was planned to take place on Corellia. Eclipse set a course for the planet, and the ''Rogue Shadow'' left orbit.<ref name="TFUn" />

====Forging an Alliance====
{{Quote|I will join his rebellion, too, if I'm welcome.''"<br />"''I thought you were still passed out in the cargo hold.''"<br />"''I finally came to.|Rahm Kota and the apprentice, at the meeting on Corellia|<ref name="TFUn" />}}
[[File:Kota_Marek_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kota, now sober, joins the fledgling group of Rebels on Corellia.]]
En route to Corellia, Kota continued the transformation back into the seasoned general he once was, a process that had truly begun when instructing the apprentice in his Force usage on Raxus Prime. Kota spent the [[Time/Legends|time]] polishing his [[Boot/Legends|boots]], cleaning his robes, and generally tidying his appearance. He even discarded the cloth that covered his eyes. The apprentice believed that Kota was still in a depressed mood, especially when the General did not join them in attending the meeting between the Senators inside a ruined building in Corellia's arctic wastes. As the meeting progressed, Kota made his entrance, declaring his intent to join the fledgling rebellion. The apprentice was surprised at his appearance, commenting that he thought Kota had been passed out drunk in the cargo hold of the ''Rogue Shadow''. Kota replied that he had finally come to his senses.<ref name="TFUn" />

As the assembled Senators pledged their commitment to create a rebellion against the Empire, Imperial troops, under the command of Darth Vader himself, attacked the congregation. As Imperial soldiers battled against the security forces that each Senator had brought, Kota used the Force to take the apprentice's lightsaber and launched himself against Vader. The Dark Lord telekinetically caught Kota with the Force, choking him until he offered no more resistance, then tossed him toward a group of waiting stormtroopers to be taken prisoner.<ref name="TFUn" />

With Kota down, Vader turned his attention to the apprentice. It became clear to the Senators that the Dark Lord and the young man knew each other, although they believed that the two were in league to expose their rebellion. While that had been their original plan, the apprentice's experiences and time with Eclipse and Kota had changed his mind about his allegiance to Vader. He had come to love Eclipse&mdash;although he was not aware of it for some time&mdash;and Kota had shown him that the dark side of the Force was not necessarily more powerful than the light, and that anger and hatred did not have to rule his life. Vader attempted to kill the apprentice but was interrupted by the droid PROXY, who took on the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a Jedi Knight from the Clone Wars. Although Vader defeated the droid easily, it gave the apprentice time to escape the confrontation.<ref name="TFUn" />

====Prisoner====
{{Quote|He's beaten. Let it go&hellip;''"<br />"''It's a trick! He's more powerful than you know. And he deserves to die for what he's done to me.''"<br />"''Maybe so. But if you kill him now, out of hatred, then you'll be back right where you began.|Rahm Kota and the apprentice, regarding Palpatine|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kotapalpatine.jpg|thumb|right|Kota attacks Palpatine with the Sith Lord's own lightsaber.]]
Captured by Imperial forces, Kota was taken to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an enormous [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] being built over the planet [[Despayre]] in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]]. Along with Organa, Mothma, and Bel Iblis, Kota was taken before Emperor Palpatine himself for interrogation and eventual execution. Before the Emperor could enact his plan, the apprentice&mdash;who had infiltrated and [[Battle on Death Star I|fought his way]] through the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] after being recovered from Corellia by Eclipse&mdash;came to their rescue. After the apprentice dueled and defeated Vader, Palpatine attempted to sway the apprentice back to the dark side, telling him to kill Vader and take his place at the Emperor's side. Kota used the Force to grab [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|Palpatine's lightsaber]] from his belt,<ref name="TFUn" /> killing two of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]] who were standing watch over the prisoners,<ref name="TFUc" /> then lunged at the Emperor. Palpatine responded by electrocuting Kota with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Organa pleaded with the apprentice to help Kota rather than slay Vader, who had been wounded in the duel. Using the Force, the apprentice sent a wave of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and debris toward the Emperor, forcing him to cease his lightning attack on the General.<ref name="TFUn" />

As the apprentice stood over the defeated Emperor, Kota knew that the young man wanted to kill Palpatine for all he had done to him. Kota told him that if he surrendered to the dark side now, all the good work he had done would be lost, and he would be right back where he had started. Although he hesitated, the apprentice stood down and prepared to leave with the Senators on the ''Rogue Shadow''. The Emperor, however, was not prepared to let them escape and unleashed more Force lightning at Kota, striking him in the back and knocking him to the ground. The apprentice moved to block the attack, taking the Emperor's lightning into his own body and then redirecting it back at Palpatine. Locked together, the apprentice told Kota and the Senators to get out. Kota and the Senators boarded the ''Rogue Shadow'',<ref name="TFUvg" /> although the General hesitated, watching the conflict between the Emperor and the apprentice before being urged to board by Organa.<ref name="TFUc" /> As Imperial reinforcements arrived, the apprentice opened himself fully to the Force, releasing a massive wave of energy that resulted in an explosion that destroyed much of the Death Star's [[Observation deck/Legends|observation deck]], injured Vader and the Emperor, and killed the apprentice himself. The ''Rogue Shadow'' escaped the Death Star just prior to the explosion, ferrying Kota and the Senators to safety.<ref name="TFUvg" />

====A declaration of Rebellion====
{{Quote|You always knew who he was, didn't you?''"<br />"''I suspected, yes.''"<br />"''Then why did you help him? After all the things he had done?''"<br />"''When he came to me in the bar, among all his dark thoughts, I glimpsed one bright spot. One beautiful thing he held onto, even at the end.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''You.|Juno Eclipse and Rahm Kota, discussing Galen Marek|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kota_Juno.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Juno Eclipse with Kota on Kashyyyk]]
Aboard the ''Rogue Shadow'', Kota reiterated the events of the apprentice's death to Eclipse, telling her that he had willingly sacrificed his own life to allow the General and Senators to escape.<ref name="TFUvg" /> At his insistence, Eclipse set a course for Kashyyyk. On the Wookiee homeworld, Kota finally learned the name of the young man&mdash;Galen Marek&mdash;after Organa did a thorough search through all available records. He was the son of two Jedi and had been born and raised on Kashyyyk until Vader had kidnapped him as a boy after slaying his father, Kento Marek.<ref name="TFUn" /> At a later meeting in the hut where the [[House of Marek|Marek family]] had lived, Senator Organa, his daughter, Bel Iblis, Mon Mothma, Eclipse, and Kota formally formed the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The [[Alliance Starbird|Marek family crest]] was taken as their own symbol, honoring Galen Marek's sacrifice.<ref name="TFUvg" /> Following the meeting, Eclipse confronted Kota, asking him if he had always known that Marek had been the one who had blinded him. Kota told her that he had indeed suspected as much. When Eclipse asked him why he had helped them, knowing what Marek had done, Kota told her of the bright spot burning within the young man that he had felt in the bar on Cloud City&mdash;and that it was her.<ref name="TFUvg" />

===The Galactic Civil War===
====A general rebel becomes a Rebel General====
{{Quote|But you ''are'' aware, no doubt, that the general's actions are not always sanctioned by the Alliance.|Mon Mothma, to Juno Eclipse|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:General_Kota_TFU2.png|thumb|right|250px|Rahm Kota, Rebel Alliance general]]
Along with Senator Organa and Eclipse, Kota travelled to Corellia, where Eclipse turned control of the ''Rogue Shadow'' over to the Jedi General. As the nascent resistance movement coalesced into the Rebel Alliance, they adopted the [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|uniform]] that had been used by Kota's Militia. Although the Alliance began to grow&mdash;acquiring ships, soldiers, and supplies&mdash;[[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] held the opinion that resources were more important than small victories. Assets were not to be risked for minimal gains, and, although small scale training missions were authorized, large scale military engagements were prohibited. Kota, however, disagreed with this position, advocating that tactical strikes made by small forces against critical targets could effectively disrupt Imperial forces throughout an entire region. To this end, he formed his own [[Kota's squad|squad]] of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] and&mdash;using the ''Rogue Shadow''&mdash;struck at Imperial targets on several worlds, including [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], against the orders of Alliance High Command. He was assisted by Eclipse, who had been given command of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. Eclipse supported his unsanctioned operations to ensure that the Alliance did not lose Kota and to keep him in check; she considered the General to be both a friend and an asset vital to the Rebellion. His missions were nonetheless considered victories for the Alliance, which in turn convinced Kota that his actions were correct and justified.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> The General also acquired a new [[Green (disambiguation)|green]]-bladed lightsaber that was virtually identical to his previous one.<ref name="TFUIIvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> At some point, the [[22nd infantry division]]&mdash;a new unit of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] that had just finished their training at a [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance training base|hidden base]] in the Outer Rim&mdash;came to Kota's attention. He noted that the troops had never seen combat before and were afraid, but that they hated the Empire with a vengeance. Kota planned to use that need for revenge and turn it against the Empire.<ref name="TFUIIvg-db">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' Databank</ref>

====Cato Neimoidia====
{{Quote|Blackout to Blackguard. Respond, please.''"<br />"''I don't have time to talk.''"<br />"''Bad luck. This is taking too long. You need to pull out.''"<br />"''Negative, Blackout. Leave if you want to. I'm staying to finish the job.|Juno Eclipse, to Rahm Kota, during the raid on Cato Neimoidia|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:Tarko-se.png|thumb|left|250px|The city of Tarko-se on Cato Neimoidia.]]
[[1 BBY/Legends|One year]] after the death of Galen Marek aboard the Death Star, Kota was informed by Eclipse that she had been assigned to take the ''Salvation'' on a training mission to the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. There, she would test her [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] crew by having them [[Space warfare/Legends|engage]] the Imperial force assigned to protect the planet. Cato Neimoidia was a hub for the transportation and redistribution of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] throughout the Empire, and was ruled by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. Tarko had amassed a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wealth]] by taking bribes from other [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] keen to acquire the best "stock" for their facilities, as well as selling the slaves on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] to criminals and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] cartels. Eclipse's orders were simple; engage the Imperial forces and test the Baron's defenses. At the same time, the mission would serve as combat experience for her crew. Under no circumstances was Eclipse to risk her ship unnecessarily.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

[[File:Merillion_Tarko.png|thumb|right|Baron Merillion Tarko.]]
Kota seized the opportunity, deciding to take the ''Rogue Shadow'' and his squad to Cato Neimoidia in an effort to take out Tarko and disrupt his slaving operation. Kota felt that a successful strike against the Baron's base would disrupt Imperial facilitates across the galaxy that relied on slaves for their operations. Kota used the ''Rogue Shadow''{{'s}} [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] to close with the Baron's seat of power,<ref name="TFUIIn" /> the sinkhole-spanning [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge city]] of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]],<ref name="TFUIIvg-db" /> strafing its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses and ground facilities. In orbit, Eclipse [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|engaged]] Tarko's defenses. She passed off Kota's ground assault as a local insurrection to her crew, who were unaware of Kota's presence in the [[Cato Neimoidia system/Legends|system]]. [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from the ''Salvation'' [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dueled]] with defending [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], while the frigate's turbolasers targeted the city itself. Kota piloted the ''Rogue Shadow'' through the battle, looking for a landing zone to put the ship down on to unload his commandos.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

As the battle progressed, both Kota and Eclipse realized that Cato Neimoidia was better defended than the data acquired by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] had indicated. Additional TIE [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] had launched from the facility, and Kota suspected that the structure identified as a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] complex was used for some other purpose, and he intended to destroy it. Eclipse contacted Kota, breaking communications silence between the two, tell him that he was taking too long, and that they needed to pull out. Her starfighter force was evenly matched, and her standing orders were to retreat and not risk the frigate. Kota understood her position and told her to leave; he, however, intended to remain and finish the job. As Eclipse began to argue her point, a massive explosion near the city removed the ''Rogue Shadow'' from the ''Salvation''{{'s}} [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Unable to reestablish communication with Kota, she believed that he had died in the detonation. With the arrival of an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by the Star Destroyer [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']] in-[[Star system/Legends|system]], Eclipse ordered the ''Salvation'' to retreat. Upon returning to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], Eclipse relayed her belief that Kota had perished on Cato Neimoidia to Mon Mothma, Garm Bel Iblis, and Leia Organa.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====Fighting for survival====
{{Quote|Why don't you sit this one out, General?''"<br />"''Never. I've got a score to settle.|Starkiller and Rahm Kota|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:Kota_gladiator.png|thumb|left|250px|Kota kills a Feeorin gladiator.]]
Kota, however, had not died, managing to land in the city with his squad. Captured by Tarko's forces, the rest of his squad was executed by the Baron. Kota was taken to the structure that Alliance Intelligence had designated as a barracks; in actuality, the structure housed a large [[Tarko-se Arena|gladiatorial arena]], where the Baron entertained thousands of beings with [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] matches. The arena was suspended from the bottom of Tarko-se itself, above the sinkhole that the city spanned. Kota, using his lightsaber, was forced to fight against waves of opponents for seven days.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> His first challenge was a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], a fearsome beast native to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TFUIIvg-db" /> Other opponents included Corellian [[Corellian slice hound|razor hounds]],<ref name="TFUIIn" /> Corellian [[Corellian slice hound|slice hounds]], an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Frank|gladiator]],<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> and stormtroopers. Fatigued, Kota was fully aware that he would eventually make a mistake but kept fighting regardless. Surly and defiant, the General made a point of noting to the Baron that he would soon be running out of executioners. On the seventh day of his captivity, the Rebel General had just killed a wave of stormtrooper opponents when a new arrival entered the arena.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

To Kota's astonishment, the new arrival appeared to be Galen Marek, whom the General had seen die on the Death Star a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] previously. However, the man before him only knew himself to be "[[Subject 1138|Starkiller]]," a clone of the original Marek who had been bred and raised on the water world of Kamino and trained to be Darth Vader's secret apprentice, as his predecessor had originally been. Starkiller had learned of the General's capture from Vader, and the Dark Lord had directed his apprentice to kill Kota as part of his [[Sith training|training]]. Starkiller, however, had also been given the memories of the original apprentice through [[flash training]] techniques. Plagued by memories of Marek's life before his death on the Death Star&mdash;especially his love for Juno Eclipse&mdash;Starkiller had rejected Vader's mastery and fled Kamino in an effort to find Eclipse. Since he knew that Kota could lead him to her, he had resolved to rescue the General from Imperial captivity.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

[[File:Galen_Marek_good_clone.png|thumb|right|Starkiller, the clone of Galen Marek]]
Although stunned by the reappearance of the young man, Kota did not have time to question Starkiller as Tarko released an immense beast known as a [[Gorog (creature)|gorog]] into the arena to kill them. While Starkiller engaged the creature with his twin lightsabers, Kota charged through the arena's seating area, heading for the skybox from where Tarko was watching the proceedings. Refusing to let the Baron escape, Kota slew anyone foolish enough to stand in his way, and, upon reaching the skybox, the Jedi killed a half dozen of Tarko's [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] aides. As the General advanced on Tarko, the Baron pulled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on him. At that moment, Starkiller arrived in the skybox after cutting a hole in the ceiling. Starkiller had maneuvered the gorog into destroying the supports that attached the arena to the hanging city above; the intent was to send both the arena and the beast into the sinkhole below. The majority of the arena fell into the sinkhole, but the skybox survived, as it was directly connected to the city by its own support.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Kota and Starkiller used their lightsabers to deflect several blaster bolts fired by stormtroopers guarding the Baron, before Starkiller killed them using Force lightning.<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> As Kota was about to kill Tarko, the entire skybox lurched. The gorog, in an effort to save itself, had taken hold of the skybox to arrest its fall. The sudden movement caused Tarko to fall out of the skybox's [[Window/Legends|window]] into the beast's open mouth. However, the gorog could not save itself and began to lose its grip on the skybox. Just before the gorog fell, the creature scooped Kota up in one of its [[Limb/Legends|hands]], then plummeted into the sinkhole below. Trapped in the gorog's massive hand, Kota began slashing at the beast's fingers with his lightsaber in an effort to stop the creature from crushing him alive. Starkiller dived after them, using the Force to catch up to the gorog, landing on its back. Using Force lightning, Starkiller managed to kill the beast before it crushed Kota. The pair clutched to the dead creature as it plummeted into the sinkhole; taking hold of Kota, Starkiller jumped off the gorog and began freefalling, using the Force to slow their descent. Taking a comlink off Starkiller, Kota used it to [[Beckon call/Legends|call]] the ''Rogue Shadow'', which had followed its programming and gone into hiding when the General had been captured. Reactivated by Kota's remote command, and flying on [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]], the ship caught up to the pair, swooping beneath them. Kota and Starkiller landed on the dorsal fuselage before entering the vessel using a topside hatch.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====Reunions and partings====
{{Quote|But now you're back, and [Mon Mothma] will ''have'' to see what an opportunity this represents. We must capitalize on it immediately&mdash;a major strike to take the fight back to the Empire&mdash;''"<br />"''Wait. Don't you want to know where I came from?''"<br />"''Why? You're back; that's all that counts.''"<br />"''But I'm ''not'' back. I'm not ''him''.|Rahm Kota and Starkiller discuss his return from the dead|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:Kota_Starkiller.png|thumb|left|250px|Kota confronts Starkiller about his priorities.]]
Aboard the ''Rogue Shadow'', Starkiller was disappointed to find that Eclipse was not with the ship. Starkiller pressed Kota for information as to her whereabouts; the General explained that Eclipse captained the ''Salvation'' and that she could be anywhere in the Outer Rim, as the Alliance Fleet was constantly on the run from the Empire. Kota was more excited at Starkiller's reappearance, believing that his return would be the galvanizing force the Alliance needed to start taking the war to the Empire. When Starkiller tried to explain his origins, Kota told him that all that mattered was that he was back. The elder Jedi dismissed the young man's revelation that he was a clone&mdash;he could feel Starkiller's presence in the Force and recognized it as the young man he had known. Kota told Starkiller to head to the [[Athega system]]; it was the last rendezvous point he had for the Fleet, and it was possible that they were either still there, or had left some indication of their future destination.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Upon arrival in the Athega system, the ''Rogue Shadow'' discovered an Imperial force that had apparently been tracking the Alliance Fleet but had failed to catch it. Evading capture and returning to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Kota watched with impatience as Starkiller attempted to find Eclipse with the Force. Believing that Starkiller was wasting his time, Kota was also disappointed that the young man did not seem interested in aiding the Rebellion and was more concerned with personal matters. A heated discussion ensued, in which Starkiller admitted that he did consider finding Eclipse to be more important, but that he still believed in the Rebellion and what it stood for. He needed to find Eclipse to settle personal issues within himself and needed space to think about his own identity. Kota&mdash;angry and impatient&mdash;did not believe Starkiller's claims to be a clone, stating that it was impossible to clone Jedi,<ref name="TFUIIn" /> and that the young man should not believe Vader's assertions as to his true nature.<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> The General was dismissive, asking the young man if he truly felt that he had time to think while the galaxy was at war. Starkiller could only say that finding Eclipse was important to him, but he promised Kota that he was no coward and would return to fight. Taking Starkiller at his word, Kota told him to take the ship, since it was his anyway, and to drop him off at a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] where he could recruit people who were willing to fight.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====Returning to the Rebellion====
{{Quote|Stay on guard. A powerful glimpse of the future like you experienced is rarely wrong.|Rahm Kota, to Starkiller, concerning the latter's vision of the Alliance Fleet under attack|<ref name="TFUIIvg" />}}
Starkiller dropped Kota off on the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="TFUIIn" /> At some point, the General was checked over by a [[Unidentified medical examiner|medical examiner]], who cataloged Kota's injuries sustained in combat in the arena. Kota had suffered seventeen fractured bones, fourteen Class II lacerations, six Class III lacerations, two Class IV lacerations, moderate abdominal hemorrhaging, a severe [[Concussion/Legends|concussion]], and five missing [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The examiner applied treatment but suspected that Kota was not in any danger, since he was in full command of his faculties during the procedures, and that the Force had aided his recovery significantly.<ref name="TFUIIvg-db" /> Following the medical examination, Kota obtained passage to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], where he recruited a new squad from local mercenaries and citizens and made contact with a local Alliance agent, [[Berkelium Shyre]]. Shyre had the coordinates of the Alliance Fleet&mdash;which was now located near the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]&mdash;and Kota intended to meet up with it as soon as possible. Before he could leave, however, Starkiller arrived on the planet and tracked Kota down. He had visited the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] and had received several visions of the future, including one where the Alliance Fleet was attacked. He had also seen Eclipse with the Fleet and that she had been injured during the attack. Starkiller knew that he needed to get to the Fleet as soon as possible in order to save Eclipse. Kota agreed, and he gathered his new squad together to provide reinforcements. Starkiller balked at the delay and wanted to leave immediately, with or without the General. Kota reminded him that if he were to turn up alone, in the midst of the Alliance Fleet, then he would be treated with outright suspicion, since he was supposed to be dead. Also, only Kota had the recognition codes to be accepted by the Fleet.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Prior to launching, Kota arranged a meeting between Starkiller and [[Ni-Ke-Vanz]], a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] he had recruited for his squad. The Cerean related his experience with cloning&mdash;learned from a [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]], a race of master cloners&mdash;and told him that Force-sensitivity got in the way of the cloning process, and that no one to his knowledge has successfully cloned a Force-sensitive being perfectly. Kota used these facts to back up his own assertion that Starkiller could not be a clone.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

[[File:Rebel_fleet_TFU2.png|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller and Kota approach the ''Salvation''.]]
The ''Rogue Shadow'', accompanied by Kota's squad's [[Unidentified Ghtroc 630 freighter|ship]], left Malastare and headed for [[Nordra]] to meet with the Alliance Fleet's outliers before moving on to the Fleet proper. During the trip, Kota gave Starkiller two [[blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] to replace the crimson ones that currently resided in his lightsabers. After passing inspection at Nordra, the ''Rogue Shadow'' made a [[Precision hyperspace jump|short hyperspace jump]] to the Fleet near the Itani Nebula. Starkiller, still unsure about his place in the Alliance, decided to give Kota full schematics and [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] coordinates to the cloning facilities he had escaped from, located at [[Timira City]] on Kamino. With the data, the Alliance could launch a major strike against the Empire. As the ''Rogue Shadow'' joined the Fleet, Kota transmitted his authorization codes, clearing them for entry. Starkiller was astonished to find that his family crest had been taken as a symbol of the Alliance; Kota told him that he was part of the Alliance whether he liked it or not.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====''Salvation''====
{{Quote|The asteroids. That's where they were hiding.''"<br />"''They must have been laying dormant ever since the fleet arrived.|Starkiller and Rahm Kota, discussing the source of the Imperial attack on the Alliance Fleet|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:Starkiller-Kota.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Starkiller and Kota arrive on the ''Salvation''.]]
Using their secured comm channel, Kota contacted Eclipse and sent her the intelligence data that Starkiller had given him regarding Kamino. When she asked the source of the information, Kota told her that it was better to see it for herself, not mentioning Starkiller or his apparent return from the dead. As the ''Rogue Shadow'' docked with the ''Salvation'', the frigate fell under [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|attacked]] by Imperial forces led by the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The attack force had been hidden in a nearby [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], awaiting the perfect moment to strike. The Imperials were on a mission to capture Eclipse and take her to Kamino, thereby forcing Starkiller to return to the water world to rescue her. There, Darth Vader would attempt to return his apprentice to the dark side, or kill him. As Imperial soldiers boarded the ''Salvation''&mdash;accompanied by the Empire's new [[Terror Trooper]]s, who used personal camouflage systems to render themselves invisible&mdash;Kota and Starkiller fought their way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], encountering the new Imperial soldiers along the way. Reaching the command center, they found the crew dead and Eclipse missing. PROXY, who had been recovered from Corellia following his attack on Vader a year previously, had been reactivated by Eclipse and was serving alongside her. The droid informed Starkiller that Fett had taken Eclipse to the cargo bay on Deck Seven. As Starkiller raced off to rescue Eclipse, he told Kota to order the attack on Kamino.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

On the bridge of the ''Salvation'', Kota relayed his plan to the Alliance. High Command agreed, having seen the need for a major and symbolic victory against the Empire after [[Heurkea operation|recruiting]] the [[Mon Calamari Resistance]] to their cause and began converging a fleet to assault Kamino. The General, assisted by his squad, coordinated the remaining crew of the frigate into taking back control of the ship from the Imperial intruders,<ref name="TFUIIn" /> all the while guiding Starkiller to Deck Seven by comlink.<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> Eventually, the attacking ships started to retreat, and Kota discovered why when he was contacted by Starkiller, who told him that Fett had taken Eclipse off the ''Salvation''. Having been told that members of the crew had repaired the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], Kota ordered the ship to head for Kamino immediately to join the assault. As the ship leaped to hyperspace, PROXY informed him that red warning lights were showing on the status boards for the ship's lower levels. Starkiller also contacted the General, telling him that there was a [[Terror Walker|large droid]] loose in the bowels of the ship, heading for the secondary [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. On Starkiller's urging, Kota dispatched troops to defend the reactor. The troops he sent were quickly overwhelmed by the Terror Walker, but Starkiller arrived in time to battle and defeat the droid, saving the ''Salvation''.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====The assault on Kamino====
{{Quote|We're getting ripped apart up here! Order the retreat!''"<br />"''Hold your position, Antilles! Keep pressing the attack! We won't get another chance to take this target!|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Rahm Kota, during the assault on Kamino|<ref name="TFUIIn" />}}
[[File:Kota_Salvation.png|thumb|right|250px|Kota, on the bridge of the ''Salvation''.]]
After dispatching the Terror Walker droid, Starkiller joined Kota on the bridge just before the ''Salvation'' dropped out of hyperspace near Kamino. Around the frigate, a dozen Alliance ships, led by the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Solidarity (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Solidarity'']], [[Assault on Kamino|engaged]] several Star Destroyers in a fierce battle. Taking command of the Alliance forces, Kota directed the battle from the bridge of the ''Salvation''. The frigate, already structurally weakened by the Imperial assault on it and the running battles that had occurred within it, took severe damage from enemy fire. Other vessels in the fleet began taking heavy damage, and Kamino's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] precluded any ground assault. Kota had directed PROXY to attempt to deactivate the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] by slicing into the computer networks, but the droid noted that it would take too long, as the damage to the ''Salvation''{{'s}} systems hampered his work. As other commanders called for a retreat, Kota angrily told them to press the attack, knowing that they only had one chance to destroy the cloning facilities. As damage to the ''Salvation'' accumulated, Starkiller proposed a daring plan to take out the shields; he would guide the ''Salvation'' into the shield, using the Force to breach it. Then, he would use the ship as a fast moving [[Missile/Legends|missile]] to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] themselves. Kota agreed, ordering the crew of the ''Salvation'' to abandon ship before heading to the ''Rogue Shadow'' with PROXY.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Starkiller succeeded in bringing down the shields, allowing the ''Rogue Shadow'' and Alliance ground forces to land, followed by fighter cover.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> On the landing platform of Timira City, Kota led his troops toward the city, intent on destroying the cloning facilities. The General and his squad briefly engaged Boba Fett&mdash;who has been forced to stay on Kamino, as he would not receive payment for his services until Starkiller was dead&mdash;before the bounty hunter fled from the confrontation.<ref name="TFUIIc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> Entering the domed city, Kota and his forces headed toward a control center to try and open up the hangar doors, which would allow Alliance starfighters to enter the city interior and provide support to the ground troops, as well as countering patrolling Imperial fighters. Harried by [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] fire, Kota and his men were rescued by Starkiller, who had used the Force to survive the descent from orbit with the frigate. He took out the snipers<ref name="TFUIIn" /> and destroyed two [[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial Dropship Transports]] that threatened the Alliance soldiers by using the Force to hurl TIE fighters into them,<ref name="TFUIIvg" /> before rejoining with the General. While Kota went to secure a command center to prevent the Imperials from locking down the city and preventing his forces from gaining ground, Starkiller opened the hangar doors using the Force. Guided by the Force, he proceeded to get to the top of the cloning spire, where Vader was holding Eclipse.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> As the young man ascended the spire, Starkiller informed Kota that Vader had [[Aberrant clone|thousands of clones]] of Galen Marek maturing, and that he was building an [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="TFUIIvg" />

[[File:Kota-Fett.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Kota engages Boba Fett in battle.]]
Fighting through the city toward the cloning facilities, Kota and his troops eventually came upon Boba Fett once more. Fett, using a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], was spying on a meeting between Starkiller and Vader and had his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] ready to take a shot to kill Starkiller, thus earning his fee from Vader. Charging at the bounty hunter, Kota ordered his men to take Fett alive. Fett, however, had other ideas and killed the Alliance soldiers in a brief battle. With only Kota and PROXY left to face the bounty hunter, the General engaged Fett but was beaten back with the butt of the bounty hunter's rifle. Grounded, Kota then ordered PROXY to attack; the droid used his holographic systems to appear as Fett's father, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The appearance of his father distracted Fett, and PROXY made good use of the confusion, defeating him. As Kota stood over the downed bounty hunter, Fett triggered a [[Sonic grenade/Legends|sonic grenade]]. The resulting explosion disorientated Kota and scrambled PROXY's audio sensors, giving Fett an opportunity to make his escape.<ref name="TFUIIc" />

====Two choices, one chance====
{{Quote|You want him dead as much as I do.''"<br />"''Yes, of course. But not yet. Not until he's told us the Empire's secrets."''<br />''"You want to take him ''prisoner''?"''<br />''"To a hidden Rebel base where we can interrogate him, put him on trial for crimes against the true Republic. And ''then'' we'll execute him, to show the galaxy that we don't need to fear him any longer.|Starkiller and Rahm Kota discuss Vader's fate|<ref name="TFUIIvg" />}}
[[File:Kota_arrests_Vader.png|thumb|right|300px|Kota stands guard over Darth Vader.]]
Accompanied by more Alliance troops, Kota and PROXY rejoined with Starkiller on one of Timira City's landing platforms. The young man had engaged Vader in a lengthy lightsaber duel and had beaten him. With the Dark Lord at his mercy, Starkiller was prepared to kill him for everything he had endured at Vader's hands. Kota counseled him not to; although the elder Jedi wanted him dead, he also wanted to take Vader prisoner and interrogate him until he revealed the Empire's secrets. Then, once they had learned everything of value, they would execute Vader to prove to the galaxy that there was no reason to fear him any longer. Starkiller, despite hating Vader and having believed that the Dark Lord had killed Eclipse during their duel, relented and spared his life. As Starkiller walked away to tend to Eclipse, Kota ignited his lightsaber and pointed it at Vader, keeping him under guard while Alliance soldiers bound him.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

With the Alliance victory at Kamino, Kota&mdash;along with Starkiller and Eclipse&mdash;prepared to transfer Vader to the Alliance's hidden [[Dantooine base/Legends|base]] on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The General reported their achievements to Leia Organa, who told them to be proud of their accomplishment, and that the capture of Vader would be a turning point for the Alliance. The ''Rogue Shadow'' would be used to transport Vader to Dantooine, while a dozen other decoy freighters would travel to other locations to mask the Alliance's true intentions. The ''Rogue Shadow'', with Kota and Starkiller acting as a security escort, left Kamino and entered hyperspace, on course for Dantooine.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

====A new recruit====
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''I am Kota, one of the few still bold enough to call themselves a Jedi. Look, clone, if you're even half the man that Falon was, the Rebel Alliance could use your help.''"<br />"''And what makes you think I care about the Rebel Alliance?''"<br />"''The Force resonates in you. Yet here you are, 'tending the land,' while the entire galaxy suffers around you.''"<br />"''&hellip;what do you want me to do?|X2 and Rahm Kota meet for the first time|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:KotaX2Dantooine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kota meets X2 on Dantooine.]]
As a member of the Rebellion, Kota was tasked by Alliance High Command to travel to the planet Dantooine to recruit his former Padawan, Falon Grey, into the fledgling resistance. Arriving at the world in [[Rahm Kota's starship|his starship]], Kota discovered that Grey was dead, killed during the subsequent [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] that had followed Order 66. Instead, he found the clone X2, Grey's genetic "son," living as a simple [[Farm/Legends|farmer]]. Grey had been killed years earlier by X1, the other of Grey's "sons," and X2 had been wounded by his brother while attempting to save Grey. Grey's last act was to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] X2's wounds before dying. Kota was disappointed to find a clone who was a mere reflection of his former Padawan and told him that he was a fool for living as a farmer when the galaxy was suffering under the heel of the Empire. Despite this, Kota sensed that the Force was with X2<ref name="ES-DS" /> and felt that Grey would have wanted him to look after the young man.<ref name="ES-PSP" /> As a result, Kota offered him a place in the Rebel Alliance, which X2 accepted.<ref name="ES-DS" />

While X2 served as a Rebel agent, Kota watched over him, offering him guidance and assistance on the missions the clone undertook. To this end, Kota ordered X2 to [[Mission to Desolation Station|infiltrate]] [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]], an Imperial base where components of the Death Star were being created and then transported to the construction site. As the Alliance was aware of the existence of the battlestation, they had begun an [[Operation Skyhook|active campaign]] to destroy the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. During the mission&mdash;which resulted in the destruction of Desolation Station&mdash;Kota relayed intelligence to X2 regarding the location of Wookiee slaves on the station, then later sent several [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] to cover X2's extraction. Sometime later, Kota learned that a [[Geonosis strike team (Rebel)|Rebel strike team]] had been captured on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] while attempting to [[Infiltration of Geonosis Imperial base|infiltrate]] an [[Geonosis Imperial base|Imperial base]] on the planet. The Jedi Master planned to rescue them and contacted X2 to assist him in the effort. Kota left for Geonosis ahead of the clone, informing X2 that he would leave a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] at the landing zone so that X2 could follow him. As the clone arrived in orbit around Geonosis, however, he encountered the bounty hunter Boba Fett, who had traveled to the planet to claim the bounty that the Empire had placed on Kota's head. The pair fought in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt around Geonosis, and Fett intended to capture X2 and use him as bait to draw out Kota. Ultimately, X2 managed to best Fett and rendezvoused with Kota at the Imperial base. The pair [[Mission to Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] the [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] strike team; the individuals were grateful to X2 for their rescue and pledged to serve him as a military unit. On Kota's suggestion, the newly formed [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] was christened as [[Grey Squadron]] in honor of Falon Grey.<ref name="ES-DS" />

====Death Star campaign====
{{Quote|The Death Star is a fearsome invention indeed. We must find a way to destroy it!|Rahm Kota|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:DeathStar1-SWE.png|thumb|right|The Death Star]]
Armed with the location of the Death Star, Kota's group organized a [[Mission to Death Star I|mission]] to infiltrate the superweapon with the intention of recovering intelligence on the station's capabilities and rescuing any prisoners held in its [[Deck 5|cells]]. X2 volunteered for the mission, and Kota assisted him, guiding the clone via comlink. During the mission, X2 first infiltrated a [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Death Star)|Star Destroyer]] guarding the station, using the ship's own weapons to destroy several defensive emplacements on the Death Star, which in turn allowed X2 to slip aboard the facility. Once onboard, X2 followed Kota's advice to use the Death Star's [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|superlaser]] to destroy the Star Destroyer that was guarding the station. The General was amazed at the firepower that the station commanded and told the clone that it was vital that the information on the weapon reached Alliance High Command. X2 managed to rescue several prisoners and collect vital information on the station before withdrawing.<ref name="ES-PSP" />

X2 and Grey Squadron regrouped with Alliance High Command at the [[Great Temple/Legends|main Rebel base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. While at the base, X2 received a recommendation from Kota that a bounty hunter named [[Shara]] would be a good addition to Grey Squadron.
